pushback_verification: All 8 verified against current state before disposition; none stale. resolutions.title: The bodies read the PR regime from `orbit status --json` field `pr`, but the bare tier's no-active-changes rung emits `{changes: [], message}` with NO `pr` key — so in any repo with zero active changes and no architecture doc the PR layer silently resolves to `never` on the first propose.
resolutions.action: Option A applied. Rung 3 of the status degradation ladder now emits `{changes: [], message, pr}` — `pr: orientation.pr` added to the literal object in `status.ts`, the ladder comment no longer promises the JSON shape is unchanged (the TEXT is; the shape gained the key every other rung carries). New test `ladder rung 3: zero live workstreams + zero parseable docs → the no-changes JSON still carries pr` writes `pr: per-proposal` into an otherwise empty project and asserts the exact key set `['changes','message','pr']`, `pr === 'per-proposal'`, and the byte-identical text render; the existing artifact-workflow no-changes JSON test (asserting `changes`/`message` values) still passes. Chose A over B because the bodies already name the bare tier and B would have documented the hole instead of closing it.

options_presented.label: A
options_presented.body: Add `pr: orientation.pr` to the rung-3 JSON object at status.ts:129 so every bare-tier `--json` shape carries the field, and add a status-orientation test for the zero-changes/zero-docs case asserting `payload.pr`. Ripple: `orbit-orientation`'s JSON requirement text (`the existing no-changes message, unchanged`, status.ts:119 comment; spec line 349-350) needs a delta line acknowledging the added key — this finding then merges with the missing-`orbit-orientation`-delta finding below.

options_presented.label: B
options_presented.body: Change the reference (pr-choreography.ts:50 and :297) and both body pointers (propose.ts:274, ff-change.ts:138) to read `orbit status --full --json`, whose `printFullView` path is unconditional and already carries `pr` on every rung (verified in the scratch project). No engine change; keeps rung 3 byte-identical. Still needs the one-line orientation delta documenting `pr` on the `--full` shape, and the reference should say WHY `--full` (the bare tier's ladder can omit the key).

resolutions.title: The archive-tail reference tells the AI to validate a stored URL live but never says what to DO when validation fails; its nearest clause ("cannot observe → skip the tail") points the reader at the opposite of the spec's behavior.
resolutions.action: Added an `On POSITIVE invalidation` bullet under tail step 2 in `PR_ARCHIVE_TAIL_SECTION`: skip ONLY the PR-writing steps (description rewrite OR stage-entry append, and the flip) with one note naming the specific reason (`closed` / `merged` / `retargeted to <base>` / `repository mismatch` / `not found`), commit and push still proceed, and a failed validation never triggers step 3's fallback query. Step 3 now spells the four query axes inline (`--repo`, `--head`, `--state open`, base-discard) so the tail reference is self-contained. The `Cannot observe` clause is reworded to say it is DISTINCT from positive invalidation (observation unavailable vs. observation answered). Verified the generated `references/pr-archive-tail.md` carries the bullet after `orbit update --force`; the repository-qualified-invocation fidelity test still passes.

resolutions.title: The resolved-regime field on the orientation surface — the ONE engine surface the bodies are now told to read — has no owning requirement, is absent from the zero-engine-git surface enumeration, and contradicts the archived `orbit-orientation` JSON-shape requirement with no delta.
resolutions.action: The spec half of option A, walked with finding 1. NEW delta `specs/orbit-orientation/spec.md` (MODIFIED `JSON output for both tiers`): reproduces the baseline requirement with `pr` on the bare and `--full` shapes, defines `pr` as the engine-resolved regime (absent/inert config → `never`, never an absent key), states it is present on EVERY bare-tier rung including the no-changes object, and adds the scenario `Every bare-tier JSON rung carries the resolved PR regime`. The zero-engine-git enumeration in `orbit-pr-lifecycle/spec.md`, design D-d6-7, and the proposal's Zero-engine-git bullet now include the read-only orientation `pr` field. `orbit validate --strict` valid; `orbit fingerprint` stamped the new base (5 verified, 0 diverged).
resolutions.resolution: Walked with finding 1 under option A: add the orbit-orientation MODIFIED delta naming pr on every bare-tier shape, and amend the zero-engine-git enumeration in the delta spec, D-d6-7, and the proposal.

resolutions.title: Neither body anchors phase 1 at a step position; for `ff` this is material because Step 2 (`orbit new change`) writes `orbit/changes/<name>/.openspec.yaml` before any 'artifact' exists, so a reader who reaches the PR section after Steps 1-5 reproduces the refused switch the ordering exists to prevent.
resolutions.action: Both PR-lifecycle sections gained a `Position` paragraph. propose: NEW Step 0.5 — phase 1 runs AFTER Step 0 mode detection and BEFORE Step 0a / upstream Step 1 (generation must land on the target branch; the generation-input precondition presupposes `orbit/explore/<name>/` still in place); phase 2 after generation + validation; phase 3 AFTER Step 0d's move, its commit scope naming the moved material and the staging deletions. ff: phase 1 BEFORE Step 2 (`orbit new change` writes `.openspec.yaml`, a path a compatible branch already tracks — the exact `git switch` refusal the harness demonstrates); phase 2 after Step 4's validation; phase 3 after Step 5. Both paragraphs say the section is placed last for reading, not for running. Propose and ff parity hashes re-pinned.

resolutions.title: The shipped `pr:` config commentary tells the user that in EVERY active mode the archive flow flips the PR READY — false for `per-architecture`, where stage archives append only and the flip is the human's act at arc-done.
resolutions.action: Reworded the `pr:` commentary block in `orbit/config.yaml`: a draft PR opens at propose in every active mode (or the single program PR is adopted/opened for a cited change); then a two-line split — per-proposal: commit, push, rewrite, flip READY; per-architecture: commit, push, APPEND this stage's entry, stage archives never flip, the READY flip is yours at arc-done. `MERGING IS ALWAYS THE USER'S ACT` kept. Grepped `src/` and the change artifacts: no other copy of the `every active mode … flips it READY` sentence exists.

resolutions.title: Category 5 Touchpoints divergence: four `actual_unpredicted` paths (two engine source files, two tests) — the engine-computed permanent record of the walk's option-A resolution, unexplained anywhere a cold reader will look.
resolutions.action: Added a dated provenance sentence under design D-d6-7 (OUTSIDE the frozen `## Touchpoints` section, which was not touched): the orientation read surface entered scope after the map froze — the first system review found the reader unreachable, the walk ratified surfacing the regime on the orientation tier, the fresh review found rung 3 omitted the key and this walk closed it — so `status.ts`, `orientation.ts`, and their tests appear as `actual_unpredicted` in every category-5 sweep by decision. Re-ran `orbit status --change d6-pr-lifecycle --boot --json`: the same four `actual_unpredicted` paths, `predicted_unsatisfied: []`, now explained where a cold reader lands.

resolutions.title: Bulk-archive's readout must name attached changes 'with their PR URLs' but the body names no source for the URL or the attachment, unlike the single archive's Step 5.45.

final_assessment: 8 of 8 resolved; 0 unresolved markers in scope. Two decision-lane findings ratified in chat as ONE decision (option A): the CRITICAL closed at the engine — the no-changes rung of the status ladder now carries `pr` like every other bare-tier shape, guarded by a rung-3 test that writes `pr: per-proposal` into an empty project — and its spec half landed as an eighth delta (`orbit-orientation`, fingerprint stamped) plus the enumeration amended in three artifacts. Six obvious fixes: the tail's positive-invalidation consequence is now performable text, both bodies anchor the three PR phases at step positions, the config commentary distinguishes the per-architecture append from the per-proposal flip, the Touchpoints divergence is explained by a provenance note outside the frozen map, the archive steps are numbered in text order, and the bulk readout names its source. 1996 -> 1997 tests green across 91 files; four parity hashes re-pinned after confirming only the four edited templates moved; local surface refreshed via `orbit update --force`. Working tree left uncommitted.
